Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the albums released by Fiona Apple prior to 1999. It incorrectly assumed "Tidal" was an album released before 1999. In reality, "Tidal" was released in 2012. The only album by Fiona Apple released prior to 1999 is "When the Pawn..." (1996). Because the agent started with the wrong set of albums (including "Tidal" and excluding "When the Pawn..."), its subsequent search for Robert Christgau's reviews was based on false premises, leading to the incorrect conclusion that "Harbinger" was the only album without a grade, when in fact "When the Pawn..." also did not receive a letter grade from Christgau.
